sources.title: Festo BionicSoftHand
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 真空吸附搬運工站
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：幾何與材料參數可追溯，沒有把線性梁模型當成仿生夾爪完整設計。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Geometry/material inputs are traceable and the linear beam is not presented as a complete bionic-gripper design.
related.difference: 區分絕對壓力與壓差、理論保持力與可用負載，建立失壓情境。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish absolute pressure from differential pressure and theoretical force from allowable load.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 矩形懸臂I=bt³/12，端點小撓度δ=FL³/(3EI)；此Euler–Bernoulli細長梁近似忽略剪變形，算例L/t=6的限制須記錄。L以三次方、t以負三次方影響撓度。 合成E=10 N/mm²、b=10 mm、t=5 mm、L=30 mm、F=0.2 N。 I=104.1667 mm⁴；δ=0.2×30³/(3×10×104.1667)=1.728 mm，δ/L=5.76%。
理論法向保持力F=ΔpA；有效面積與密封、表面粗糙及動態負載會改變實際能力。 教學圓吸盤有效直徑40 mm，壓差60 kPa，質量2 kg，靜態比較係數2。 A=π(0.04²)/4=0.00125664 m²；F=75.3982 N，需求2×2×9.81=39.24 N。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For a rectangular cantilever I=bt³/12 and small tip deflection δ=FL³/(3 EI). This Euler–Bernoulli slender-beam approximation omits shear deformation, a limitation at this example’s L/t=6; length and thickness enter cubically. Synthetic E 10 N/mm², b 10 mm, t 5 mm, L 30 mm, F 0.2 N. I=104.1667 mm⁴;δ=1.728 mm and δ/L=5.76%.

Theoretical normal force F=Δ pA; effective area, sealing, roughness and dynamics affect actual capability. Teaching effective diameter 40 mm, pressure difference 60 k Pa, mass 2 kg, static comparison factor 2. A=0.00125664 m²; F=75.3982 N versus demand 39.24 N.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 自動化光學檢查產線
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：幾何與材料參數可追溯，沒有把線性梁模型當成仿生夾爪完整設計。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Geometry/material inputs are traceable and the linear beam is not presented as a complete bionic-gripper design.
related.difference: 由混淆矩陣同時計算漏檢與誤剔，避免用高準確率掩蓋少數瑕疵。
related.differenceEn: Calculate missed defects and false rejects from a confusion matrix instead of hiding rare defects behind high accuracy.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 矩形懸臂I=bt³/12，端點小撓度δ=FL³/(3EI)；此Euler–Bernoulli細長梁近似忽略剪變形，算例L/t=6的限制須記錄。L以三次方、t以負三次方影響撓度。 合成E=10 N/mm²、b=10 mm、t=5 mm、L=30 mm、F=0.2 N。 I=104.1667 mm⁴；δ=0.2×30³/(3×10×104.1667)=1.728 mm，δ/L=5.76%。
召回率TP/(TP+FN)，精確率TP/(TP+FP)；母體缺陷比例會改變精確率。 合成1000件，瑕疵100件：TP90、FN10；良品900件：FP18、TN882。 召回90%，精確90/108=83.333%，準確(90+882)/1000=97.2%；97.2%仍漏10件瑕疵。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For a rectangular cantilever I=bt³/12 and small tip deflection δ=FL³/(3 EI). This Euler–Bernoulli slender-beam approximation omits shear deformation, a limitation at this example’s L/t=6; length and thickness enter cubically. Synthetic E 10 N/mm², b 10 mm, t 5 mm, L 30 mm, F 0.2 N. I=104.1667 mm⁴;δ=1.728 mm and δ/L=5.76%.

Recall=TP/(TP+FN), precision=TP/(TP+FP); prevalence affects precision. Synthetic 1000 parts,100 defective: TP 90, FN 10;900 good: FP 18, TN 882. Recall 90%, precision 83.333%, accuracy 97.2%; the high accuracy still misses 10 defects.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
